Relative Log-Expression (RLE), implemented (Anders Huber 2010), samples used compute reference sample, sample compared reference sample using log-ratios offset median log-ratio. Geometric Mean Pairwise Ratio (GMPR), introduced (Chen et al. 2018) sample compared compute median log-ratio offset sample geometric means pairwise ratios. Wrench, introduced (Kumar et al. 2018) fully implemented Wrench package, samples used compute reference proportions sample compared reference using ratios (log-ratios) proportions compute compositional correction factors. case, offset product (geometrically centered) compositional factors (geometrically centered) depths. offset computed counts matrix using compute_offset function changing offset argument: particular example, counts sparse sophisticated offset methods fail (numeric output hidden) can mitigate problem RLE offset adding pseudocounts counts although drawbacks. better solution consists using positive counts compute offsets: Finally, can use wrench compute offsets: Note TSS methods produces offset scale counts, others produces offsets (hopefully) proportional library sizes different scale. force offsets scale counts methods, can use option scale = "count".

title: Data importation in PLNmodels
text: Reading biom file requires bioconductor package biomformat. package standard dependency PLNmodels needs installed separately. can easily prepare data biom file using following steps: read biom file biomformat::read_biom() extract count table biomformat::biom_data() extract covariates biomformat::sample_metadata() (build ) feed prepare_data illustrated :
code: ## If biomformat is not installed, uncomment the following lines # if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) { #   install.packages("BiocManager") # } # BiocManager::install("biomformat") library(biomformat) biomfile <- system.file("extdata", "rich_dense_otu_table.biom", package = "biomformat") biom <- biomformat::read_biom(biomfile) ## extract counts counts <- as(biomformat::biom_data(biom), "matrix") ## extract covariates (or prepare your own) covariates <- biomformat::sample_metadata(biom) ## prepare data my_data <- prepare_data(counts = counts, covariates = covariates) str(my_data)

title: Analyzing multivariate count data with the Poisson log-normal model
text: multivariate Poisson lognormal model (short PLN, see Aitchison Ho (1989)) relates pp-dimensional observation vectors 𝐘i\mathbf{Y}_i pp-dimensional vectors Gaussian latent variables 𝐙i\mathbf{Z}_i follows latent space 𝐙i∼𝒩(𝛍,𝚺),observation space Yij|Zijindep.𝐘i|𝐙i∼𝒫(exp{𝐙i}).\begin{equation}   \begin{array}{rcl}   \text{latent space } &   \mathbf{Z}_i \sim \mathcal{N}({\boldsymbol\mu},\boldsymbol\Sigma), \\   \text{observation space } &  Y_{ij} | Z_{ij} \quad \text{indep.} &   \mathbf{Y}_i | \mathbf{Z}_i\sim\mathcal{P}\left(\exp\{\mathbf{Z}_i\}\right).   \end{array} \end{equation} parameter 𝛍{\boldsymbol\mu} corresponds main effects latent covariance matrix 𝚺\boldsymbol\Sigma describes underlying residual structure dependence pp variables. following figure provides insights role played different layers PLN: geometrical view

title: Analyzing multivariate count data with the Poisson log-normal model
text: model generalizes naturally formulation closer multivariate generalized linear model, main effect due linear combination dd covariates 𝐱i\mathbf{x}_i (including vector intercepts). also let possibility add offsets pp variables sample, 𝐨i\mathbf{o}_i. Hence, previous model generalizes $$\begin{equation}   \mathbf{Y}_i | \mathbf{Z}_i \sim \mathcal{P}\left(\exp\{\mathbf{Z}_i\}\right), \qquad \mathbf{Z}_i \sim \mathcal{N}({\mathbf{o}_i + \mathbf{x}_i^\top\mathbf{B}},\boldsymbol\Sigma), \\ \end{equation}$$ 𝐁\mathbf{B} d×pd\times p matrix regression parameters. individuals =1,…,ni=1,\dots,n stacked together, data matrices available feed model n×pn\times p matrix counts 𝐘\mathbf{Y} n×dn\times d matrix design 𝐗\mathbf{X} n×pn\times p matrix offsets 𝐎\mathbf{O} Inference PLN focuses regression parameters 𝐁\mathbf{B} covariance matrix 𝚺\boldsymbol\Sigma.

title: Supervized classification of multivariate count table with the Poisson discriminant Analysis
text: vein Fisher (1936) Rao (1948), introduce multi-class LDA model multivariate count data variant Poisson Lognormal model Aitchison Ho (1989) (see PLN vignette reminder). Indeed, can viewed PLN model discrete group structure latent Gaussian space. PLN-LDA model can written hierarchical framework sample pp-dimensional observation vectors 𝐘i\mathbf{Y}_i related pp-dimensional vectors latent variables 𝐙i\mathbf{Z}_i discrete structure KK groups following way: group structure 𝛍i=μgigi∈{1,…,K}latent space 𝐙iindep.𝐙i∼𝒩(𝛍i,𝚺)observation space Yij|Zijindep.Yij|Zij∼𝒫(exp{Zij})\begin{equation}    \begin{array}{rcl}     \text{group structure }   & \mathbf{\mu}_i = \mu_{g_i} & g_i \\{1, \dots, K\}  \\     \text{latent space }   & \mathbf{Z}_i \quad \text{indep.} & \mathbf{Z}_i \sim \mathcal{N}({\boldsymbol\mu}_i, \boldsymbol{\Sigma})  & \\     \text{observation space } & Y_{ij} | Z_{ij} \quad \text{indep.} & Y_{ij} | Z_{ij} \sim \mathcal{P}\left(\exp\{Z_{ij}\}\right)   \end{array} \end{equation} gig_i denotes group sample ii belongs . different parameters 𝛍k∈ℝp{\boldsymbol\mu}_k \\mathbb{R}^p corresponds group-specific main effects variance matrix 𝚺\boldsymbol{\Sigma} shared among groups. equivalent way writing model following: latent space 𝐙i∼𝒩(𝛍i,𝚺)𝛍i=𝐠i⊤𝐌observation space Yij|Zijindep.Yij|Zij∼𝒫(exp{Zij}),\begin{equation}    \begin{array}{rcl}   \text{latent space } &   \mathbf{Z}_i \sim \mathcal{N}({\boldsymbol\mu}_i,\boldsymbol\Sigma) & \boldsymbol{\mu}_i = \mathbf{g}_i^\top \mathbf{M} \\   \text{observation space } &  Y_{ij} | Z_{ij} \quad \text{indep.} & Y_{ij} | Z_{ij} \sim \mathcal{P}\left(\exp\{Z_{ij}\}\right),   \end{array} \end{equation} , slight abuse notation, 𝐠i\mathbf{g}_i group-indicator vector length KK (gik=1⇔gi=kg_{ik} = 1 \Leftrightarrow g_i = k) 𝐌=[𝛍1⊤,…,𝛍K⊤]⊤\mathbf{M} = [\boldsymbol{\mu}_1^\top, \dots, \boldsymbol{\mu}_K^\top]^\top K×pK \times p matrix collecting group-specific main effects.

text: Given: new observation 𝐘\mathbf{Y} associated offset 𝐨\mathbf{o} covariates 𝐱\mathbf{x} model estimated parameters 𝚺̂\hat{\boldsymbol{\Sigma}}, 𝐁̂\hat{\mathbf{B}}, 𝐌̂\hat{\mathbf{M}} group counts (n1,…,nK)(n_1, \dots, n_K) can predict observation’s group using Bayes rule follows: k∈1,…,Kk \{1, \dots, K}, compute fk(𝐘)=p(𝐘|𝐠=k,𝐨,𝐱,𝐁̂,𝚺̂)=𝚽PLN(𝐘;𝐨+𝛍k+𝐱⊤𝐁̂,𝚺̂)pk=nk∑k′=1Knk′\begin{equation} \begin{aligned} f_k(\mathbf{Y}) & = p(\mathbf{Y} | \mathbf{g} = k, \mathbf{o}, \mathbf{x}, \hat{\mathbf{B}}, \hat{\boldsymbol{\Sigma}}) \\                 & = \boldsymbol{\Phi}_{PLN}(\mathbf{Y}; \mathbf{o} + \boldsymbol{\mu}_k + \mathbf{x}^\top \hat{\mathbf{B}}, \hat{\boldsymbol{\Sigma}}) \\ p_k             & = \frac{n_k}{\sum_{k' = 1}^K n_{k'}}     \end{aligned} \end{equation} 𝚽PLN(•;𝛍,𝚺)\boldsymbol{\Phi}_{PLN}(\bullet; \boldsymbol{\mu}, \boldsymbol{\Sigma}) density function PLN distribution parameters (𝛍,𝚺)(\boldsymbol{\mu}, \boldsymbol{\Sigma}). fk(𝐘)f_k(\mathbf{Y}) pkp_k respectively plug-estimates () probability observing counts 𝐘\mathbf{Y} sample group kk (ii) probability sample originates group kk. posterior probability π̂k(𝐘)\hat{\pi}_k(\mathbf{Y}) observation 𝐘\mathbf{Y} belongs group kk likely group k̂(𝐘)\hat{k}(\mathbf{Y}) can thus defined π̂k(𝐘)=pkfk(𝐘)∑k′=1Kpk′fk′(𝐘)k̂(𝐘)=arg⁡maxk∈{1,…,K}π̂k(𝐘)\begin{equation} \begin{aligned} \hat{\pi}_k(\mathbf{Y}) & = \frac{p_k f_k(\mathbf{Y})}{\sum_{k' = 1}^K p_{k'} f_{k'}(\mathbf{Y})} \\ \hat{k}(\mathbf{Y})     & = \underset{k \\{1, \dots, K\}}{\arg\max} \hat{\pi}_k(\mathbf{Y}) \end{aligned} \end{equation}

text: zero-inflated PLN model (ZIPLN) (Batardière et al. 2025) combines Poisson lognormal model (Aitchison Ho 1989) – see PLN vignette – zero-inflation mechanism: count YijY_{ij} either structural zero (probability πij\pi_{ij}) drawn usual PLN generative process: latent space 𝐙i∼𝒩(𝛍,𝚺)zero-inflation Wij∼ℬ(πij)independent 𝐙iobservation space Yij|Zij,Wij=0∼𝒫(exp{Zij}),Yij|Wij=1=0\begin{equation}   \begin{array}{rcl}   \text{latent space } &   \mathbf{Z}_i \sim \mathcal{N}\left({\boldsymbol\mu},\boldsymbol\Sigma\right) & \\   \text{zero-inflation } &  W_{ij} \sim \mathcal{B}(\pi_{ij}) & \text{independent } \mathbf{Z}_i\\   \text{observation space } &  Y_{ij} \,|\, Z_{ij}, W_{ij} = 0 \sim \mathcal{P}\left(\exp\{Z_{ij}\}\right), &  Y_{ij} \,|\, W_{ij} = 1 \;=\; 0   \end{array} \end{equation} Just like PLN, 𝛍{\boldsymbol\mu} generalizes 𝐨i+𝐱i⊤𝐁\mathbf{o}_i + \mathbf{x}_i^\top\mathbf{B} account offsets covariates. zero-inflation probabilities πij\pi_{ij} can parameterized several ways, controlled zi argument ZIPLN(): "single": single π\pi shared entries (default). "row": one πi\pi_i per sample. "col": one πj\pi_j per species. covariates: logit(πij)=𝐱0,⊤𝐁0,j\text{logit}(\pi_{ij}) = \mathbf{x}_{0,}^\top\mathbf{B}_{0,j}, specified formula syntax Y ~ PLN effect | ZI effect (see ). ZIPLNnetwork adds sparsity penalty 𝛀=𝚺−1\boldsymbol\Omega = \boldsymbol\Sigma^{-1}, exactly PLNnetwork PLN (see PLNnetwork vignette Chiquet et al. (2019)), excess zeros residual dependency structure taxa accounted . See Tous et al. (2025) application species association networks count data structural zeros.

title: Zero-inflated PLN models for multivariate count data with excess zeros
text: fit plain PLN model four ZIPLN parameterizations, sampling site covariate count part, check much accounting zero-inflation improves fit: Accounting zero-inflation brings large improvement plain PLN, letting zero-inflation probability depend body site (zi_site) gives best BIC ICL among parameterizations considered – surprising given different four body sites .
code: myPLN     <- PLN(Abundance ~ 0 + site + offset(log(Offset)), data = microcosm) zi_single <- ZIPLN(Abundance ~ 0 + site + offset(log(Offset)), data = microcosm) zi_row    <- ZIPLN(Abundance ~ 0 + site + offset(log(Offset)), data = microcosm, zi = "row") zi_col    <- ZIPLN(Abundance ~ 0 + site + offset(log(Offset)), data = microcosm, zi = "col") zi_site   <- ZIPLN(Abundance ~ 0 + site + offset(log(Offset)) | 0 + site, data = microcosm) data.frame(   model  = c("PLN", "ZIPLN (single)", "ZIPLN (row)", "ZIPLN (col)", "ZIPLN (site-dependent)"),   loglik = c(myPLN$loglik, zi_single$loglik, zi_row$loglik, zi_col$loglik, zi_site$loglik),   BIC    = c(myPLN$BIC, zi_single$BIC, zi_row$BIC, zi_col$BIC, zi_site$BIC),   ICL    = c(myPLN$ICL, zi_single$ICL, zi_row$ICL, zi_col$ICL, zi_site$ICL) ) %>% knitr::kable(digits = 1)

title: Poisson Lognormal Models
text: Poisson lognormal model variants1 can used variety multivariate problems count data play. package implements efficient variational algorithms fit models, accompanied set functions visualization diagnostic. See dedicated vignettes comprehensive introduction. PLNmodels covers following models, built around multivariate Poisson-lognormal distribution sharing common formula-based interface (covariates, offsets, weights) choice optimization backends (fast built-Newton solver, NLOPT, experimental torch backend): PLN2: unpenalized multivariate Poisson regression, several covariance structures (full, diagonal, spherical, fixed, genetic/heritability structure). PLNPCA3: probabilistic Poisson PCA — rank-constrained covariance dimension reduction visualization. PLNLDA: Poisson lognormal discriminant analysis4 supervised classification count data. PLNnetwork5: sparse inverse-covariance (network) inference via graphical-lasso-like penalty6. PLNmixture: model-based clustering7 count data via mixture PLN models. ZIPLN8: zero-inflated extension PLN data excess zeros, family covariance structures optional sparse (ZIPLNnetwork9) variant.

title: Control of a PLNLDA fit — PLNLDA_param
text: backend optimization back used, either "nlopt" "torch". Default "nlopt" trace integer verbosity. covariance character setting model covariance matrix. Either "full", "diagonal" "spherical". Default "full". config_post list controlling post-treatments (optional bootstrap, jackknife, R2, etc.). See details config_optim list controlling optimizer (either "nlopt" "torch" backend). See details inception Set parameters initialization: default, model initialized multivariate linear model applied log-transformed data, formula one provided user. However, user can provide PLNfit (typically obtained previous fit), sometimes speeds inference.

title: Control of a PLNLDA fit — PLNLDA_param
text: list parameters configuring fit.

title: Control of a PLNLDA fit — PLNLDA_param
text: list parameters config_optim controls optimizers. "nlopt" chosen following entries relevant "algorithm" optimization method used NLOPT among LD type, e.g. "CCSAQ", "MMA", "LBFGS". See NLOPT documentation details. Default "CCSAQ". "maxeval" stop number iteration exceeds maxeval. Default 10000 "ftol_rel" stop optimization step changes objective function less ftol multiplied absolute value parameter. Default 1e-8 "xtol_rel" stop optimization step changes every parameters less xtol multiplied absolute value parameter. Default 1e-6 "ftol_abs" stop optimization step changes objective function less ftol_abs. Default 0.0 (disabled) "xtol_abs" stop optimization step changes every parameters less xtol_abs. Default 0.0 (disabled) "maxtime" stop optimization time (seconds) exceeds maxtime. Default -1 (disabled) "profiled" (full covariance ) TRUE, profile B Omega every nlopt evaluation instead running EM loop (Omega fixed duration inner nlopt solve, B profiled closed form every evaluation). Despite extra O(n*p^2 + p^3) cost per evaluation, benchmarks found consistently faster EM loop (slightly better loglik) across range problem sizes. Default TRUE; set FALSE recover EM loop. "torch" backend used (PLN PLNLDA now), following entries relevant: "algorithm" optimizer used torch among RPROP (default), RMSPROP, ADAM ADAGRAD "maxeval" stop number iteration exceeds maxeval. Default 10 000 "numepoch" stop training number epochs exceeds numepoch. Set -1 enable infinite training. Default 1 000 "num_batch" number batches use training. Defaults 1 (use full dataset epoch) "ftol_rel" stop optimization step changes objective function less ftol multiplied absolute value parameter. Default 1e-8 "xtol_rel" stop optimization step changes every parameters less xtol multiplied absolute value parameter. Default 1e-6 "lr" learning rate. Default 0.1. "momentum" momentum factor. Default 0 (momentum). used RMSPROP "weight_decay" Weight decay penalty. Default 0 (decay). used RPROP "step_sizes" pair minimal (default: 1e-6) maximal (default: 50) allowed step sizes. used RPROP "etas" pair multiplicative increase decrease factors. Default (0.5, 1.2). used RPROP "centered" TRUE, compute centered RMSProp gradient normalized estimation variance weight_decay (L2 penalty). Default FALSE. used RMSPROP "builtin" backend used, following entries relevant "maxeval" stop number Newton steps inner loop exceeds maxeval. Default 10000 "ftol_in" stop inner loop objective changes less ftol_in (relative). Default 1e-8 "maxit_em" stop EM outer loop number EM iterations exceeds maxit_em. Default 50 "ftol_em" stop EM outer loop ELBO changes less ftol_em (relative). Default 1e-8 list parameters config_post controls post-treatment processing (PLN*() functions), following entries (defaults may vary depending specific function, check config_post_default_* defaults values): jackknife boolean indicating whether jackknife performed evaluate bias variance model parameters. Default FALSE. bootstrap integer indicating number bootstrap resamples generated evaluate variance model parameters. Default 0 (inactivated). variational_var boolean indicating whether variational Fisher information matrix computed estimate variance model parameters (highly underestimated). Default FALSE. sandwich_var boolean indicating whether sandwich estimation used estimate variance model parameters (highly underestimated). Default FALSE. rsquared boolean indicating whether approximation R2 based deviance computed. Default TRUE

title: Control of PLNPCA fit — PLNPCA_param
text: backend optimization backend, either "nlopt" (default, NLOPT/CCSAQ, recommended PLNPCA: conservative per-variable steps reliably find global basin even singular-value ratio d1/sqrt(n) large), "builtin" (home-made optimizer, profiled trust-region Newton), "torch" (experimental: automatic differentiation via torch package; tends find lower loglik "nlopt" "builtin" datasets — recommended). "builtin" backend profiles variational parameters (M, S) per-observation Newton VE-step optimises loadings (B, C) saddle-aware trust-region Newton resulting objective (analytic Schur Hessian-vector products, Jacobi-preconditioned Steihaug-CG). reliably reaches higher variational bound "nlopt" small/moderate data comparable speed, faster large data; tuning keys config_optim: cg_maxit, maxit_out, ftol_out, gtol, delta0. large data (many samples variables) reduced-Hessian landscape indefinite outer trust-region iteration converges slowly keeps improving bound, capped maxit_out (default 150) rather gradient tolerance: higher ranks trade quality time. best variational bound large data, raise , e.g. config_optim = list(maxit_out = 300). trace integer verbosity. config_optim list controlling optimizer (either "nlopt" "torch" backend). See details config_post list controlling post-treatments (optional bootstrap, jackknife, R2, etc.). See details inception optional pre-fitted PLNfit object. provided, variational means M regression coefficients B used compute shared SVD svd(M - X*B) initialises ranks simultaneously. replaces default LM-based starting point gives highest-quality initialisation large ranks. NULL (default), see init_method. init_method ignored inception set. Recommendation: large ranks (rank > sqrt(p)) complex datasets, prefer init_method = "EM" (cheap, gains) inception = PLN(formula, data) (maximum quality, full convergence cost). init_method character: strategy used compute starting point shared SVD. "LM" (default): fast multivariate lm.fit log-transformed counts. Good small moderate ranks (rank <= sqrt(p)). Recommended default. "GLM": p independent Poisson GLMs. Rarely better "LM" PLNPCA; recommended. "EM": run init_niter variational EM iterations full PLN (builtin backend) computing SVD, giving latent mean M closer true posterior. Recommended large ranks (rank > sqrt(p)), noticeably improves loglik negligible extra cost. Caution: hurts small ranks, -converged M reduces low-rank SVD discriminability. Ignored inception provided. init_niter integer: number PLN EM iterations init_method = "EM". Default 5. sweet spot 2–10: beyond ~10 M -converges toward full PLN optimum, degrading low-rank SVD hurting small-rank models. Ignored "LM" "GLM". sequential logical. TRUE, ranks fitted ascending order model warm-started converged solution previous rank: loadings C augmented new columns inception SVD, latent scores M variances S2 padded zeros / 0.01 respectively. Disables parallel fitting across ranks. Default FALSE.

title: Control of PLNPCA fit — PLNPCA_param
text: list parameters configuring fit.

title: Control of PLNPCA fit — PLNPCA_param
text: list parameters config_optim controls optimizers. "nlopt" chosen following entries relevant "algorithm" optimization method used NLOPT among LD type, e.g. "CCSAQ", "MMA", "LBFGS". See NLOPT documentation details. Default "CCSAQ". "maxeval" stop number iteration exceeds maxeval. Default 10000 "ftol_rel" stop optimization step changes objective function less ftol multiplied absolute value parameter. Default 1e-8 "xtol_rel" stop optimization step changes every parameters less xtol multiplied absolute value parameter. Default 1e-6 "ftol_abs" stop optimization step changes objective function less ftol_abs. Default 0.0 (disabled) "xtol_abs" stop optimization step changes every parameters less xtol_abs. Default 0.0 (disabled) "maxtime" stop optimization time (seconds) exceeds maxtime. Default -1 (disabled) "profiled" (full covariance ) TRUE, profile B Omega every nlopt evaluation instead running EM loop (Omega fixed duration inner nlopt solve, B profiled closed form every evaluation). Despite extra O(n*p^2 + p^3) cost per evaluation, benchmarks found consistently faster EM loop (slightly better loglik) across range problem sizes. Default TRUE; set FALSE recover EM loop. "torch" backend used (PLN PLNLDA now), following entries relevant: "algorithm" optimizer used torch among RPROP (default), RMSPROP, ADAM ADAGRAD "maxeval" stop number iteration exceeds maxeval. Default 10 000 "numepoch" stop training number epochs exceeds numepoch. Set -1 enable infinite training. Default 1 000 "num_batch" number batches use training. Defaults 1 (use full dataset epoch) "ftol_rel" stop optimization step changes objective function less ftol multiplied absolute value parameter. Default 1e-8 "xtol_rel" stop optimization step changes every parameters less xtol multiplied absolute value parameter. Default 1e-6 "lr" learning rate. Default 0.1. "momentum" momentum factor. Default 0 (momentum). used RMSPROP "weight_decay" Weight decay penalty. Default 0 (decay). used RPROP "step_sizes" pair minimal (default: 1e-6) maximal (default: 50) allowed step sizes. used RPROP "etas" pair multiplicative increase decrease factors. Default (0.5, 1.2). used RPROP "centered" TRUE, compute centered RMSProp gradient normalized estimation variance weight_decay (L2 penalty). Default FALSE. used RMSPROP "builtin" backend used, following entries relevant "maxeval" stop number Newton steps inner loop exceeds maxeval. Default 10000 "ftol_in" stop inner loop objective changes less ftol_in (relative). Default 1e-8 "maxit_em" stop EM outer loop number EM iterations exceeds maxit_em. Default 50 "ftol_em" stop EM outer loop ELBO changes less ftol_em (relative). Default 1e-8 list parameters config_post controls post-treatment processing (PLN*() functions), following entries (defaults may vary depending specific function, check config_post_default_* defaults values): jackknife boolean indicating whether jackknife performed evaluate bias variance model parameters. Default FALSE. bootstrap integer indicating number bootstrap resamples generated evaluate variance model parameters. Default 0 (inactivated). variational_var boolean indicating whether variational Fisher information matrix computed estimate variance model parameters (highly underestimated). Default FALSE. sandwich_var boolean indicating whether sandwich estimation used estimate variance model parameters (highly underestimated). Default FALSE. rsquared boolean indicating whether approximation R2 based deviance computed. Default TRUE

code: PLN_param(   backend = c("nlopt", "builtin", "torch"),   trace = 1,   covariance = c("full", "diagonal", "spherical", "fixed", "genpop"),   Omega = NULL,   C = NULL,   config_post = list(),   config_optim = list(),   inception = NULL,   init_method = c("LM", "GLM") )

title: Control of a PLN fit — PLN_param
text: backend optimization backend, either "nlopt" (default), "builtin" "torch". "nlopt" (CCSAQ, config_optim$profiled = TRUE) consistently faster "builtin". "builtin" built-envelope-theorem Newton optimizer; can reach slightly better optimum, advantage tends grow p — prefer last bit ELBO matters speed, typically large p. "torch" experimental: may converge suboptimal solutions fail datasets. trace integer verbosity. covariance character setting model covariance matrix. Either "full", "diagonal", "spherical", "fixed" "genpop". Default "full". Omega precision matrix latent variables. Inverse Sigma. Must specified covariance "fixed" C fixed p x p correlation matrix (e.g. genetic relationship matrix). Must specified covariance "genpop": residual covariance modeled Sigma = sigma2 * (rho * C + (1 - rho) * ), sigma2 rho estimated. config_post list controlling post-treatments (optional bootstrap, jackknife, R2, etc.). See details config_optim list controlling optimizer (either "nlopt" "torch" backend). See details inception Set parameters initialization: default, model initialized multivariate linear model applied log-transformed data, formula one provided user. However, user can provide PLNfit (typically obtained previous fit), sometimes speeds inference. init_method character: strategy starting-point computation (ignored inception PLNfit). Either "LM" (default) "GLM" (p independent Poisson GLMs, better complex unbalanced designs). See compute_PLN_starting_point().

title: Control of a PLN fit — PLN_param
text: list parameters configuring fit.

title: Control of a PLN fit — PLN_param
text: list parameters config_optim controls optimizers. "nlopt" chosen following entries relevant "algorithm" optimization method used NLOPT among LD type, e.g. "CCSAQ", "MMA", "LBFGS". See NLOPT documentation details. Default "CCSAQ". "maxeval" stop number iteration exceeds maxeval. Default 10000 "ftol_rel" stop optimization step changes objective function less ftol multiplied absolute value parameter. Default 1e-8 "xtol_rel" stop optimization step changes every parameters less xtol multiplied absolute value parameter. Default 1e-6 "ftol_abs" stop optimization step changes objective function less ftol_abs. Default 0.0 (disabled) "xtol_abs" stop optimization step changes every parameters less xtol_abs. Default 0.0 (disabled) "maxtime" stop optimization time (seconds) exceeds maxtime. Default -1 (disabled) "profiled" (full covariance ) TRUE, profile B Omega every nlopt evaluation instead running EM loop (Omega fixed duration inner nlopt solve, B profiled closed form every evaluation). Despite extra O(n*p^2 + p^3) cost per evaluation, benchmarks found consistently faster EM loop (slightly better loglik) across range problem sizes. Default TRUE; set FALSE recover EM loop. "torch" backend used (PLN PLNLDA now), following entries relevant: "algorithm" optimizer used torch among RPROP (default), RMSPROP, ADAM ADAGRAD "maxeval" stop number iteration exceeds maxeval. Default 10 000 "numepoch" stop training number epochs exceeds numepoch. Set -1 enable infinite training. Default 1 000 "num_batch" number batches use training. Defaults 1 (use full dataset epoch) "ftol_rel" stop optimization step changes objective function less ftol multiplied absolute value parameter. Default 1e-8 "xtol_rel" stop optimization step changes every parameters less xtol multiplied absolute value parameter. Default 1e-6 "lr" learning rate. Default 0.1. "momentum" momentum factor. Default 0 (momentum). used RMSPROP "weight_decay" Weight decay penalty. Default 0 (decay). used RPROP "step_sizes" pair minimal (default: 1e-6) maximal (default: 50) allowed step sizes. used RPROP "etas" pair multiplicative increase decrease factors. Default (0.5, 1.2). used RPROP "centered" TRUE, compute centered RMSProp gradient normalized estimation variance weight_decay (L2 penalty). Default FALSE. used RMSPROP "builtin" backend used, following entries relevant "maxeval" stop number Newton steps inner loop exceeds maxeval. Default 10000 "ftol_in" stop inner loop objective changes less ftol_in (relative). Default 1e-8 "maxit_em" stop EM outer loop number EM iterations exceeds maxit_em. Default 50 "ftol_em" stop EM outer loop ELBO changes less ftol_em (relative). Default 1e-8 list parameters config_post controls post-treatment processing (PLN*() functions), following entries (defaults may vary depending specific function, check config_post_default_* defaults values): jackknife boolean indicating whether jackknife performed evaluate bias variance model parameters. Default FALSE. bootstrap integer indicating number bootstrap resamples generated evaluate variance model parameters. Default 0 (inactivated). variational_var boolean indicating whether variational Fisher information matrix computed estimate variance model parameters (highly underestimated). Default FALSE. sandwich_var boolean indicating whether sandwich estimation used estimate variance model parameters (highly underestimated). Default FALSE. rsquared boolean indicating whether approximation R2 based deviance computed. Default TRUE

title: Control of a PLNmixture fit — PLNmixture_param
text: backend optimization back used, either "builtin", "nlopt" "torch". Default "builtin". trace integer verbosity. covariance character setting model covariance matrices mixture components. Either "full", "diagonal" "spherical". Default "spherical". init_cl initial clustering apply. Either, 'kmeans', CAH' user defined clustering given list  clusterings, size equal number clusters considered. Default 'kmeans'. smoothing smoothing apply. Either, 'none', forward', 'backward' ''. Default ''. config_optim list controlling optimizer (either "nlopt" "torch" backend). See details config_post list controlling post-treatments (optional bootstrap, jackknife, R2, etc.). See details inception Set parameters initialization: default, model initialized multivariate linear model applied log-transformed data, formula one provided user. However, user can provide PLNfit (typically obtained previous fit), sometimes speeds inference.

title: Control of a PLNmixture fit — PLNmixture_param
text: list parameters configuring fit.

title: Control of a PLNmixture fit — PLNmixture_param
text: list parameters config_optim controls optimizers. "nlopt" chosen following entries relevant "algorithm" optimization method used NLOPT among LD type, e.g. "CCSAQ", "MMA", "LBFGS". See NLOPT documentation details. Default "CCSAQ". "maxeval" stop number iteration exceeds maxeval. Default 10000 "ftol_rel" stop optimization step changes objective function less ftol multiplied absolute value parameter. Default 1e-8 "xtol_rel" stop optimization step changes every parameters less xtol multiplied absolute value parameter. Default 1e-6 "ftol_abs" stop optimization step changes objective function less ftol_abs. Default 0.0 (disabled) "xtol_abs" stop optimization step changes every parameters less xtol_abs. Default 0.0 (disabled) "maxtime" stop optimization time (seconds) exceeds maxtime. Default -1 (disabled) "profiled" (full covariance ) TRUE, profile B Omega every nlopt evaluation instead running EM loop (Omega fixed duration inner nlopt solve, B profiled closed form every evaluation). Despite extra O(n*p^2 + p^3) cost per evaluation, benchmarks found consistently faster EM loop (slightly better loglik) across range problem sizes. Default TRUE; set FALSE recover EM loop. "torch" backend used (PLN PLNLDA now), following entries relevant: "algorithm" optimizer used torch among RPROP (default), RMSPROP, ADAM ADAGRAD "maxeval" stop number iteration exceeds maxeval. Default 10 000 "numepoch" stop training number epochs exceeds numepoch. Set -1 enable infinite training. Default 1 000 "num_batch" number batches use training. Defaults 1 (use full dataset epoch) "ftol_rel" stop optimization step changes objective function less ftol multiplied absolute value parameter. Default 1e-8 "xtol_rel" stop optimization step changes every parameters less xtol multiplied absolute value parameter. Default 1e-6 "lr" learning rate. Default 0.1. "momentum" momentum factor. Default 0 (momentum). used RMSPROP "weight_decay" Weight decay penalty. Default 0 (decay). used RPROP "step_sizes" pair minimal (default: 1e-6) maximal (default: 50) allowed step sizes. used RPROP "etas" pair multiplicative increase decrease factors. Default (0.5, 1.2). used RPROP "centered" TRUE, compute centered RMSProp gradient normalized estimation variance weight_decay (L2 penalty). Default FALSE. used RMSPROP "builtin" backend used, following entries relevant "maxeval" stop number Newton steps inner loop exceeds maxeval. Default 10000 "ftol_in" stop inner loop objective changes less ftol_in (relative). Default 1e-8 "maxit_em" stop EM outer loop number EM iterations exceeds maxit_em. Default 50 "ftol_em" stop EM outer loop ELBO changes less ftol_em (relative). Default 1e-8 list parameters config_post controls post-treatment processing (PLN*() functions), following entries (defaults may vary depending specific function, check config_post_default_* defaults values): jackknife boolean indicating whether jackknife performed evaluate bias variance model parameters. Default FALSE. bootstrap integer indicating number bootstrap resamples generated evaluate variance model parameters. Default 0 (inactivated). variational_var boolean indicating whether variational Fisher information matrix computed estimate variance model parameters (highly underestimated). Default FALSE. sandwich_var boolean indicating whether sandwich estimation used estimate variance model parameters (highly underestimated). Default FALSE. rsquared boolean indicating whether approximation R2 based deviance computed. Default TRUE

title: Control of a PLNmixture fit — PLNmixture_param
text: PLNmixture_param() adds parameters controlling EM smoothing outer loops: "ftol_em" outer EM solver stops objective changes less ftol_em (relative). Default 1e-3 "maxit_em" outer EM solver stops number iterations exceeds maxit_em. Default 50 "it_smooth" number iterations smoothing procedure. Default 1.

title: Control of PLNnetwork fit — PLNnetwork_param
text: backend optimization backend, either "builtin" (Newton, default) "nlopt" (CCSAQ) "torch". default combines "builtin" maxit_ve = 1 inception_niter = 5 (see maxit_ve inception_backend): consistently finds better ELBO plain "nlopt", essentially speed. Without good inception, "builtin" alone (maxit_ve = NULL) can converge poor basin large datasets — use "nlopt" want opt whole combination. inception_cov Covariance structure used inception PLN: "full" (default), "diagonal" "spherical". Non-full structures now fully supported: inception_cov != "full", penalty grid built empirical covariance latent residuals M − X·B (full-rank proxy Σ), avoiding broken max_pen = 0 previously occurred diagonal/spherical. inception_backend character NULL (default, .e. backend). Backend inception PLN ; penalty grid models always use backend. Ignored inception supplied user. inception_niter integer NULL. Limits inception PLN many iterations (EM iterations "builtin", function evaluations × 10 "nlopt"). Default 5L backend = "builtin" (NULL, .e. full convergence, otherwise): fewer iterations keep latent mean M -converging toward unconstrained optimum, make harder warm-start sparse penalty models. Values ~20 typically hurt. inception_cov != "full" inception_niter set, penalty grid uses empirical residual covariance crossprod(M − X·B) / n max_pen. maxit_ve integer NULL. Maximum number inner VE-step iterations per outer GLASSO alternation turn. Default 1L backend = "builtin" (NULL, .e. full convergence — maxit_em "builtin", maxeval "nlopt" — otherwise). maxit_ve = 1 implements partial E-step (generalized EM): one Newton step per outer turn prevents -convergence causes oscillations GLASSO M-step — see backend full default combination benchmark. trace integer verbosity. n_penalties integer specifies number values penalty grid internally generated. Ignored penalties non NULL min_ratio penalty grid ranges minimal value produces sparse value multiplied min_ratio. Default 0.1. penalize_diagonal boolean: diagonal terms penalized graphical-Lasso? Default TRUE penalty_weights either single list p x p matrix weights (default: weights equal 1) adapt amount shrinkage pairs node. Must symmetric positive values. config_post list controlling post-treatments (optional bootstrap, jackknife, R2, etc.). See details config_optim list controlling optimizer (either "nlopt" "torch" backend). See details inception Set parameters initialization: default, model initialized multivariate linear model applied log-transformed data, formula one provided user. However, user can provide PLNfit (typically obtained previous fit), sometimes speeds inference.

title: Control of PLNnetwork fit — PLNnetwork_param
text: list parameters configuring fit.

title: Control of PLNnetwork fit — PLNnetwork_param
text: list parameters config_optim controls optimizers. "nlopt" chosen following entries relevant "algorithm" optimization method used NLOPT among LD type, e.g. "CCSAQ", "MMA", "LBFGS". See NLOPT documentation details. Default "CCSAQ". "maxeval" stop number iteration exceeds maxeval. Default 10000 "ftol_rel" stop optimization step changes objective function less ftol multiplied absolute value parameter. Default 1e-8 "xtol_rel" stop optimization step changes every parameters less xtol multiplied absolute value parameter. Default 1e-6 "ftol_abs" stop optimization step changes objective function less ftol_abs. Default 0.0 (disabled) "xtol_abs" stop optimization step changes every parameters less xtol_abs. Default 0.0 (disabled) "maxtime" stop optimization time (seconds) exceeds maxtime. Default -1 (disabled) "profiled" (full covariance ) TRUE, profile B Omega every nlopt evaluation instead running EM loop (Omega fixed duration inner nlopt solve, B profiled closed form every evaluation). Despite extra O(n*p^2 + p^3) cost per evaluation, benchmarks found consistently faster EM loop (slightly better loglik) across range problem sizes. Default TRUE; set FALSE recover EM loop. "torch" backend used (PLN PLNLDA now), following entries relevant: "algorithm" optimizer used torch among RPROP (default), RMSPROP, ADAM ADAGRAD "maxeval" stop number iteration exceeds maxeval. Default 10 000 "numepoch" stop training number epochs exceeds numepoch. Set -1 enable infinite training. Default 1 000 "num_batch" number batches use training. Defaults 1 (use full dataset epoch) "ftol_rel" stop optimization step changes objective function less ftol multiplied absolute value parameter. Default 1e-8 "xtol_rel" stop optimization step changes every parameters less xtol multiplied absolute value parameter. Default 1e-6 "lr" learning rate. Default 0.1. "momentum" momentum factor. Default 0 (momentum). used RMSPROP "weight_decay" Weight decay penalty. Default 0 (decay). used RPROP "step_sizes" pair minimal (default: 1e-6) maximal (default: 50) allowed step sizes. used RPROP "etas" pair multiplicative increase decrease factors. Default (0.5, 1.2). used RPROP "centered" TRUE, compute centered RMSProp gradient normalized estimation variance weight_decay (L2 penalty). Default FALSE. used RMSPROP "builtin" backend used, following entries relevant "maxeval" stop number Newton steps inner loop exceeds maxeval. Default 10000 "ftol_in" stop inner loop objective changes less ftol_in (relative). Default 1e-8 "maxit_em" stop EM outer loop number EM iterations exceeds maxit_em. Default 50 "ftol_em" stop EM outer loop ELBO changes less ftol_em (relative). Default 1e-8 list parameters config_post controls post-treatment processing (PLN*() functions), following entries (defaults may vary depending specific function, check config_post_default_* defaults values): jackknife boolean indicating whether jackknife performed evaluate bias variance model parameters. Default FALSE. bootstrap integer indicating number bootstrap resamples generated evaluate variance model parameters. Default 0 (inactivated). variational_var boolean indicating whether variational Fisher information matrix computed estimate variance model parameters (highly underestimated). Default FALSE. sandwich_var boolean indicating whether sandwich estimation used estimate variance model parameters (highly underestimated). Default FALSE. rsquared boolean indicating whether approximation R2 based deviance computed. Default TRUE

title: Control of ZIPLNnetwork fit — ZIPLNnetwork_param
text: backend optimization backend, either "builtin" (default, joint Newton (M,ψ,R), combined partial E-step maxit_ve = 1) "nlopt" (CCSAQ). "builtin" consistently finds better ELBO across penalty path cost slower. inception_cov Covariance structure used inception PLN: "full" (default), "diagonal" "spherical". Non-full structures now fully supported: inception_cov != "full", penalty grid built empirical covariance latent residuals M − X·B (full-rank proxy Σ), avoiding broken max_pen = 0 previously occurred diagonal/spherical. trace integer verbosity. n_penalties integer specifies number values penalty grid internally generated. Ignored penalties non NULL min_ratio penalty grid ranges minimal value produces sparse value multiplied min_ratio. Default 0.1. penalize_diagonal boolean: diagonal terms penalized graphical-Lasso? Default TRUE penalty_weights either single list p x p matrix weights (default: weights equal 1) adapt amount shrinkage pairs node. Must symmetric positive values. config_post list controlling post-treatments (optional bootstrap, jackknife, R2, etc.). See details config_optim list controlling optimizer (either "nlopt" "torch" backend). See details inception Set parameters initialization: default, model initialized multivariate linear model applied log-transformed data, formula one provided user. However, user can provide PLNfit (typically obtained previous fit), sometimes speeds inference.

Available schemes "TSS" (Total Sum Scaling, default), "CSS" (Cumulative Sum Scaling, used metagenomeSeq), "RLE" (Relative Log Expression, used DESeq2), "GMPR" (Geometric Mean Pairwise Ratio, introduced Chen et al., 2018), Wrench (introduced Kumar et al., 2018) "none". title: Compute offsets from a count data using one of several normalization schemes — compute_offset
text: RLE additional pseudocounts type arguments add pseudocounts observed counts (defaults 0L) compute offsets using positive counts (type == "poscounts"). mimics behavior DESeq2::DESeq() using sfType == "poscounts". CSS additional reference argument choose location function used compute reference quantiles (defaults median Nature publication can set mean reproduce behavior functions cumNormStat* metagenomeSeq). Wrench two additional parameters: groups specify sample groups type either reproduce exactly default Wrench::wrench() behavior (type = "wrench", default) use simpler heuristics (type = "simple"). Note () CSS normalization fails median absolute deviation around quantiles become instable high quantiles (limited count variations within across samples) /one sample less two positive counts, (ii) RLE fails common species across samples (unless type == "poscounts" specified) (iii) GMPR fails sample share species samples. PLNmodels 1.3.0-9010
text: New built-Newton optimizer (backend = "builtin") PLN, ZIPLN PLNnetwork: envelope-theorem Newton steps strong Wolfe line search, dependency NLOPT. Substantially faster accurate nlopt large datasets full covariance. PLNPCA’s "builtin" backend rewritten profiled trust-region Newton: variational block (M, S) profiled per-observation Newton VE-step, loadings (B, C) optimised saddle-aware trust-region Newton resulting objective (analytic Schur-complement Hessian-vector products, Jacobi-preconditioned Steihaug-CG) — replacing previous spectral projected-gradient "builtin". reliably reaches higher variational bound "nlopt" comparable--better speed; tuning keys cg_maxit, maxit_out, ftol_out, gtol, delta0 config_optim (see ?PLNPCA_param). "nlopt" remains default PLNPCA. Backend defaults revisited package-wide, based extensive benchmarking: PLN PLNPCA keep "nlopt" (PLN now consistently faster thanks profiled = TRUE, see ); PLNnetwork ZIPLNnetwork now default "builtin", finds better optimum modest speed cost; ZIPLN keeps "builtin" default. backends remain configurable via backend argument; see corresponding *_param() documentation trade-offs. torch backend now clearly marked experimental everywhere. Quality speed improvements: config_optim$profiled = TRUE now default full-covariance nlopt fits (faster, slightly better loglik); ZIPLN’s variational step now optimises (M, ψ, R) jointly via Newton instead sequentially; PLNPCA shares single SVD initialisation across ranks can warm-start pre-fitted PLNfit large ranks (inception/init_method, see ?PLNPCA_param); ZIPLN’s starting point longer relies pscl::zeroinfl (now internal LM + binomial GLM routine), much faster better starting point — pscl longer dependency. Fixed critical nlopt convergence bug affecting PLN/PLNPCA: ill-conditioned covariate scaling trigger XTOL stopping criterion iterations, well convergence. built-backend never affected; nlopt now also fixed via better parameter scaling.

title: PLNmodels 1.3.0-9010
text: Shared covariance abstraction: optimization machinery PLN’s covariance structures (full, diagonal, spherical, fixed) now expressed via small set C++ traits (CovTraitsBase covariance_pln.h) instead duplicated per structure. PLNPCA ZIPLN’s variational step now reuse machinery instead separate hand-rolled implementations, removing substantial amount duplicated code fixing minor inefficiencies along way (e.g. ZIPLN’s VE-step used treat precision matrix dense even diagonal/spherical covariance, unnecessary O(np^2) cost). Consistent C++ naming: exported optimizer functions across PLN, PLNPCA ZIPLN now follow {backend}_optimize_{structure} convention.

title: PLNmodels 1.3.0-9010
text: Uniform covariate normalization: normalize_covariates() helper (zero mean, unit variance per column) now applied consistently optimize() methods (PLN, PLNPCA, PLNnetwork, ZIPLN). makes nlopt XTOL criterion scale-invariant stabilises torch backend. Parallelism backend: future.apply::future_lapply replaced parallel::mclapply throughout (stability selection PLNnetwork / ZIPLNnetwork). Use options(mc.cores = N) set number cores. Bug fixes: PLNnetwork/ZIPLNnetwork’s inception (warm-start) model didn’t inherit ftol_em/maxit_em user’s config_optim, silently falling back defaults producing wrong penalty grid; PLNPCA rank-model objective used − Y use − Y ⊙ Z; various ZIPLN prediction/initialization fixes (#146, #149, #150, #152). microcosm data now included (#153, #154); AIC added PLN ZIPLN classes (#151); fixes (#155).
